subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: After the cleanup blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, keep it draft until the Scout/Lobster pilot and RFC settle, or move this surface to a host/plugin-owned package?
rationale: The implementation is a new sensitive backup artifact contract, and the PR body explicitly treats the Scout/Lobster pilot as an operational evidence checkpoint before core acceptance.

options.title: Clean up and keep core candidate
options.body: Fix the lockfile and startup-policy blockers, then let the assigned maintainer decide whether the local artifact command is ready to leave draft.

options.title: Hold for pilot evidence
options.body: Keep this PR open as draft until the Scout/Lobster plugin-path evidence decides snapshot frequency, size, and ownership.

options.title: Move out of core
options.body: Close or replace this with a host/plugin-owned artifact command if core should only expose lower-level seams for now.

recommendation.title: Clean up and keep core candidate
recommendation.body: Fix the lockfile and startup-policy blockers, then let the assigned maintainer decide whether the local artifact command is ready to leave draft.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current live assignee and already reviewed the core snapshot invariant in this PR discussion.
